name: Suzuri
source:
Member of the Special Division 3 of the demon supervision unit. He was originally sent to the Special Division 3 through no fault of his own. He knew Hozumi and there was no one else who could work well with him. Currently occupied doing paperwork due to an injury. Has a cheerful personality, is friendly and has many acquaintances. He also takes good care of Mahora.

[Translated from [url=http://lovedelivery.biz/suito/chara.html]the official website[/url].]
